# A-FORGE — Constitutional Execution Shell
> Event-sourced agent runtime. Planner/Executor/Verifier triad, policy engine, governed memory.
> Port: 7071. License: AGPL-3.0. Status: OPERATIONAL. Version: 2026.06.06.

## Quick Context
- **What:** Execution shell — builds, deploys, runs as systemd service
- **Role:** EXECUTES approved plans. Hard-gated by judge + APEX. Never autonomous.
- **Federation:** A-FORGE executes. arifOS authorizes. Arif commands.
- **Runtime:** TypeScript, Node 22+, Express, bare-metal systemd

## Key Files
- README.md — Full human-readable narrative (842 lines)
- AGENTS.md — Agent rules, build/test commands
- GENESIS/012_AFORGE_MANDATE.md — Constitutional mandate
- CONTEXT.md — Live organ state

## Entry Points
- src/ — TypeScript source (~130 files, ~24K lines)
- src/engine/ — AgentEngine, PlanValidator, execution runtime
- src/planner/ — ParallelPlanner, dependency resolution
- src/memory/ — Governed memory, context compression
- src/governance/ — Policy engine, 888_HOLD gates
- src/bridges/ — Federation organ bridges (MCP, A2A)
- src/a2a/ — Agent-to-Agent protocol
- src/ops/ — Health, federation probe, telemetry
- src/cli/ — CLI interface

## Build & Test
- Install:  npm install
- Build:   npm run build   (tsc -p tsconfig.json)
- Test:    make test        (security-audit + build + all 17 test suites)
- Start:   systemctl start a-forge
- Health:  curl http://127.0.0.1:7071/health
- Probe:   curl http://127.0.0.1:7071/api/federation-probe
- Deploy:  make build && systemctl restart a-forge

## API Endpoints
GET  /health                  — Liveness probe
GET  /api/federation-probe    — 6-organ parallel health scan
GET  /.well-known/agent-card.json — A2A agent card
POST /tasks                   — A2A task submission

## Architecture (W2/W3 hexagonal ports)
Domain layer    — Pure business logic, no I/O
Infrastructure  — Systemd, filesystem, Docker, network
Interfaces      — Express routes, MCP bridges, A2A handlers

## Boundaries (NEVER)
- NEVER execute without JUDGE_SEAL_AUTHORIZATION + APEX approval
- NEVER legislate (A-FORGE executes, arifOS legislates)
- NEVER self-authorize a forge gate
- NEVER bypass the reversibility scoring
- NEVER auto-deploy to production without human 888
